title: DDP-GCN: Multi-Graph Convolutional Network for Spatiotemporal Traffic Forecasting

novelty_points.claim: 提出DDP-GCN，将道路之间的距离、方向与位置关系共同纳入图卷积网络，建模交通速度预测中的空间依赖。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes DDP-GCN, incorporating distance, direction, and positional relationships between roads into graph convolution for traffic speed forecasting.
technical_features: 除距离外，显式考虑交通方向与位置关系两类空间依赖。
将三种空间关系设计为基本图构件并纳入深度神经网络。
technical_features_en: Explicitly considers direction and positional relationships in addition to distance.
Designs basic graph building blocks for the three spatial relationships and incorporates them into deep neural networks.
